answer: The shale assignment is published and ferrous records each panel. Shards are assigned from the oasis graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4581 identities would post 4877 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
